annotation.text: Two similar triangles sharing the vertex C. Large triangle ABC has a smaller triangle PQC inside it. Side PQ is parallel to side AB, and Q is the midpoint of side BC, so triangle PQC is half the size of triangle ABC.
Large triangle ABC. Vertex B is at the bottom left, vertex C is at the bottom right, and vertex A is at the top, above and slightly to the right of B. Side BC is horizontal.
Vertex A, the top of the large triangle
Vertex B, the bottom left corner
Vertex C, the bottom right corner, shared by both triangles
Angle ABC, at vertex B, measures 70 degrees
Small triangle PQC, inside triangle ABC. Vertex Q is on side BC, halfway between B and C, and vertex P is above Q, on the line from Q parallel to BA.
Vertex P, the top of the small triangle
Vertex Q, the midpoint of side BC
Angle BQP, at vertex Q on the left, measures 110 degrees. It is supplementary to angle PQC, which measures 70 degrees, the same as angle ABC.
